issue.title: bugyi-chops toobig_split bridge and planning tests fail: they patch removed sase.agent.names.get_reserved_family_names and expect old lumberjack wait-runner prompts

task_type_fields.why_not_flake:
Proposed by sase-1eq.8 (PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP #1) and re-reproduced by the sase-1eq land agent on 2026-10-05. Four bugyi-chops tests fail on a clean bugyi-chops master (8cbc4de), both against published sase 0.17.0 (sase-1eq.8's run) and against dev sase 17c2907d3b (`PYTHONPATH=src <sase venv>/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_toobig_split.py -k "test_sase_planning_emits_one_summary_and_promotes_a_surviving_tail or test_sase_bridge_"`, 4 failed). The macro rename did not cause them: they reproduce on the base tree, before the bugyi-chops macro import change.

Failures:
- test_sase_bridge_skips_stale_queued_files_without_agent_launch, test_sase_bridge_launches_eligible_file_after_admission, and test_sase_bridge_promotes_next_basename_member_when_first_skips raise AttributeError: module 'sase.agent.names' has no attribute 'get_reserved_family_names'. The tests monkeypatch a sase internal that no longer exists.
- test_sase_planning_emits_one_summary_and_promotes_a_surviving_tail fails _assert_planned_prompts_use_lumberjack_wait_runners (assert all(...) is False). The planned queue prompts no longer have the lumberjack wait-runner shape the test expects.

Likely fix: move the bridge tests to whatever sase seam replaced get_reserved_family_names, and update the planning assertion to the current wait-runner prompt contract, or fix toobig_split if the contract regressed.

issue.creation_reason: Four bugyi-chops tests have been red on a clean tree since at least 2026-10-03, so the plugin's just check cannot pass. Proposed by sase-1eq.8 and re-reproduced by the sase-1eq land agent.
